ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) base with a high-contrast ratio of approximately 1:8 white to black pixels; high-intensity pixels are concentrated in point-source clusters and linear segments.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density white point-masses clustered on the peripheral region of the left lobe; sparse spotting on the right lobe; prominent high-intensity linear strokes concentrated on the right lobe surface; high-intensity aggregates present at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch; interior angle estimated at approximately 60 degrees; vertical depth relative to lobe maxima is high.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; localized ragged morphology at the distal tips with pixel-level 'peaks' and 'valleys' ranging from 10-30 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature on the trailing edge, sweeping upward from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular and sub-circular white pixel clusters located on the mid-to-outer portion of the left lobe; scattered individual circular clusters across the central-ventral region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, high-intensity linear streaks; multiple diagonal and horizontal rake-like marks observed primarily on the right lobe; vertical linear disruptions visible near the center-right median notch boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extremely irregular and ragged distal tips on both lobes indicating significant physical trauma or erosion; multiple sets of overlapping rake marks (linear abrasions) on the right-lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-density stippling pattern isolated to the outer margin of the left lobe.
